manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps changing it: a = -g. The gate releases a second ball at that moment. Both then fall together from rest. No air resistance.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes side by side show a tossed ball on the left and a dropped ball on the right. Velocity and acceleration vectors accompany each ball alongside numerical callouts.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
